About the Fermentation Project

 

Opportunities to taste a fermented coffee alongside its unfermented counterpart are incredibly rare. The Fermentation Project gives coffee lovers around the world the chance to compare them side by side, exploring how different fermentation methods and processing techniques shape the flavour of the very same coffee.

 

To make this possible, four coffees have been produced from the same lot using four different fermentation processes. By keeping the origin, variety and all other variables constant, the project highlights how microbiological activity during fermentation alone can influence the final cup.


About Lucia Solis

 

Lucia Solis is a leading coffee fermentation and processing consultant. She studied Viticulture and Enology at the University of California, Davis, specialising in microbiology and fermentation science. After nine years in wine production in Napa Valley, she transitioned to coffee in 2014.

 

With more than 12 years of international experience across over 15 coffee-producing countries, Lucia helps producers simplify processing from fermentation through to drying. Applying microbiological principles, she develops practical, scalable processing systems that deliver greater consistency, improved operational control and higher-value coffees.

 

For the Fermentation Project, Lucia designed and oversaw the four distinct fermentation protocols, creating a unique educational tasting experience that demonstrates the impact fermentation can have on flavour while keeping every other variable as consistent as possible.

 

Taste Along with James Hoffmann


Join James Hoffmann for a live guided tasting on 3rd October, 3pm, where he'll be brewing and comparing the same coffees alongside thousands of coffee lovers worldwide. Explore how each fermentation and processing method influences flavour while sharing the experience and learning together.

products.title: Popayán, Colombia
products.body_html:
Popayán is located in Colombia’s Cauca region at 1700 metres above sea level, an ideal setting for growing high-quality coffee.

 

The area, known as the Meseta de Popayán, is sheltered by the Andes mountain range, which creates stable climate and altitude conditions. This consistency helps produce high quality cherries with beans that produce well-rounded, bright and juicy cups.

 

A perfect balance of comforting and vibrant, Popayán is extremely forgiving in all extraction levels.

 

Brewed for a shorter time, this coffee is fresh, juicy and zesty.

Brewed for longer and it becomes more balanced, with sweet caramel notes and a smooth body.

products.title: El Diviso, Colombia (Experimental Decaf)
products.body_html:
Located in Pitalito, in the south of Huila, El Diviso has become known for its forward-thinking approach to Colombian speciality coffee. Led by Néstor Lasso, the farm focuses on experimental processing, rare varieties and innovative methods to continually raise the bar for quality.

 

This lot is the Ombligón varietal, a popular competition choice and valued for its vibrant sweetness and delicate complexity. This coffee has undergone a carefully controlled experimental process, beginning with controlled oxidation, followed by anaerobic fermentation, and finished with a thermal shock to halt fermentation at just the right point, all designed to highlight its naturally sweet and fruity character.


Once the final process of Sugarcane decaffeination is complete, the end result is this absolutely stunning rollercoaster of fruit and floral flavours. A sensory kaleidoscope of the very best. We’re only at the start of discovering what speciality decaf can truly offer.

products.title: House Bundle
products.body_html:
Grab yourself an armful of OddKin's signature House Blends!

One day you're feeling like you need something tradish and cosy, and then the next you're a bit spicier and feeling adventurous, this bundle of 3 bags covers all your bases.

 

Clubhouse is our much loved ol' reliable. Oozing with sweet chocolate with extra POW! She's the pick when you want something full and rich.

 

Treehouse is the next step up with a little more fruit in the mix. Think strawberry dipped chocolate for a mid-morning treat.

 

Jazzhouse is gonna be the one that seesaws away from tradition and takes your tastebuds to a tropical paradise.

 

Get all of these, plus free shipping!


Bundle of:

1x 250g Clubhouse Blend

1x 250g Treehouse Blend

1x 250g Jazzhouse Blend

products.title: Jazzhouse Blend
products.body_html:
You asked, we answered!

 

A unique, seasonally evolving blend that’s fruity, bouncy and complex enough to challenge the status quo.

An excellent blend is a thing of beauty and no small feat. Getting high quality beans to harmonise and sing together rather than perform as a one man band is a skill in itself. We’ve carefully crafted this range to be both tantalisingly different yet consistently reliable, Jazzhouse is that party that keeps thriving!

 

With a "bassline" of biscuity and velvety natural Bossa Nova from Brazil, lifted by the sweetness and acidity from a washed Paradise Mountain of Papua New Guinea, and the wild top note of a rotating seasonal fruit co-ferment. This current one is using Sweet Nectar Co-fermented coffee from Luz Helena Salazar.

 

Jazzhouse is currently blasting out notes of Tropical Fruit, Honey & Strawberry. 

Super sweet, hella aromatic and juicy.

products.title:
Bristol's DECAF

"Bristol Coffee Festival" Coffee
products.body_html:
For the second year running, we are again the proud main coffee sponsor for Bristol Coffee Festival 2026!

And once more, we're launching limited run of festival bespoke coffee also known as Bristol's "Bristol Coffee Festival" Coffee (BBCFC for short).

 

But this time, we stopped and thought "But wait! Hang on. What about the hardcore coffee lovers that just drink it for the vibes?"

 

Well, worry no more! We got you sleep lovers a grand treat of our very first Decaf edition of BBCFC!... DBBCFC for short. (Ironically, not very short).

 

But what the name of this coffee lacks in letters and caffeine, it makes up for big time in flavour, complexity and character!

 

Okay, but what actually is DBBCFC?

We did the complete unthinkable and blended some seriously high-quality decaf coffees together to create an absolute bombshell of a coffee. 

 

Bilidimoo Bensa Bombe from Ethiopia, naturally processed brings all the summer berry character. From world-renowned coffee producer Nestor Lasso, Advanced Natural El Diviso adds complexity, texture and candy-like sweetness

 

All capped off with our classic washed Popayán for a beautifully rounded finish, making this blend work wonders across a whole range of brewing methods.

 

Think juicy summer berries, red wine and sticky, sweet jelly babies when black, and raspberry jam, cream and Haribo foam hearts in milk.
